name: UP Scholarship
description: Independent educational information website providing clear, step-by-step guidance on UP Scholarship (Uttar Pradesh Scholarship) 2026-27 - covering OTR registration, online application, login, status check, last date, renewal, payment, correction, eligibility, required documents, PFMS status and NPCI/Aadhaar bank linking.
audience: Students and guardians in Uttar Pradesh, India applying for or managing government scholarships
disclaimer: This site does not process applications, registrations or payments. All official scholarship actions must be completed on the official Uttar Pradesh Scholarship portal at scholarship.up.gov.in.
